title: Every meaningful operation becomes a structured Experience
decision: RAIOS V9 records meaningful work as structured Experience objects rather than relying on logs alone.
reason: The construction process itself must train the future system.
Failures and corrections are valuable cognitive capital.
Reusable procedures cannot be compiled from unstructured terminal history reliably.
Experience capture enables the recursive V9 development flywheel.
promotion_rule: Experience does not become canonical skill automatically.
